_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of the Azure Login action's metadata file (action.yml) at release v3.1.0. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.
name: Azure Login action (action.yml)
license: MIT (LICENSE, copied from the repository root).
not_copied: README.md: its sample workflows duplicate the Learn page pinned in ../azure-login-oidc-sample; the chapter links it.

src/, lib/ (the compiled action), __tests__/, scripts/, package.json, package-lock.json and the rest: examples/drift-pipeline only reads the declared inputs and their defaults, and never runs the action.
